title: Process lifecycle
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: Two termination signals arrive during shutdown. The server closes twice, causing duplicate resource cleanup and lost error handling. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Register SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers with an idempotent shutdown gate and detach listeners after cleanup.
Repair node-graceful-lifecycle and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for process lifecycle.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.07 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
